privileged_info_for_vlm: The target orbit for a 16-day / 233-revolution repeat cycle is approximately: Semi-Major Axis (SMA) = 7077.7 km (acceptable range 7070-7100 km), Inclination = 98.19 degrees (acceptable range 98.0-98.5 deg).
